method: Non-administrator, formally approved read-only Win32_Process basic metadata plus Win32_Service PID mapping. No process image handle query or alternative access to a rejected handle.

configured_file_readonly_validation.limit: Validates the file named by SCM configuration. Actual loaded process image was not opened or hashed; do not equate configured path/disk signature with a direct process-memory identity proof.

official_documentation.purpose: ETW Host is a Windows event collection service used by dotTrace Timeline profiling and JetBrains dynamic program analysis. It can be installed independently and auto-start with Windows; Rider/ReSharper/dotTrace/SelfAPI can use it.
official_documentation.lifetime: Its existence after a Rider window closes does not by itself indicate a leftover Rider child process.

conclusion: PID 4624 is mapped by SCM to the pre-existing automatic ETW service, with services.exe as parent and a creation time days before this Rider test. It is not a child created by our Rider launches. The previous guard correctly stopped while this candidate was unclassified; this read-only task now identifies it as a shared service, not evidence of a live Rider IDE session.
